name: Vows
overview: Scripture reveals that vows are solemn promises made to God, as exemplified by Jacob who vowed to serve the Lord if He would provide and protect him (Genesis 28:20-22). These commitments are serious and must be fulfilled, as God holds individuals accountable for what they have vowed, even if initially hidden from them (Leviticus 5:4-5). Vows are not casual declarations but sacred pledges that involve both voluntary intention and faithful performance.
